Name: Blessings Of The Valley
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Have you felt like the statue of blessings was lacking - especially for the investment you have to put in to get it? I certainly have. Which is why I was elated to see that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25267]Custom Blessings Framework[/url] came out!

This mod adds 22 more blessings to the statue, now you have a wide selection of possibilities! 

Spoiler for all of the new Blessings:
[spoiler]Blessing Of The Spirits: +2 Luck
Blessing Of The Fisherman: +2 Fishing
Blessing Of Magnetism: + 100 Magnetism
Blessing Of Dwarven Kind: + 3 Mining
Blessing Of The Harvest: + 4 Farming
Blessing Of Protection: +2 Defense
Blessing Of The Warrior: +45 Max Stamina, +1 Defense, +3 Attack, +2 Combat
Blessing Of The Earth: +1 Luck, +2 Foraging, +2 Farming
Blessing Of The Wind: +1 Speed
Blessing Of Criticality: +5% Crit Chance, +5% Crit Power
Blessing Of Precision: +10 % Weapon Precision
Blessing Of Strength: +10% Attack
Blessing Of Repulsion: +10% Knockback
Blessing Of Immunity: +5 Immunity
Blessing Of The Falcon: +10% Weapon Speed
Blessing Of Yoba: +1 Luck, +1 Speed, +2 Immunity, + 3% Weapon Speed
Blessing of Health: + 10 Max Health
Blessing of Regeneration: ~+1 Heath per tick
Blessing of Refreshment: ~+1 Stamina per tick
Blessing of Vitality: ~.05 Health and .05 Stamina per tick
Blessing of Invincibility: +25 Max Stamina, +1 Defense, +1 Immunity, +5 Max Health, ~.03 Health and .03 Stamina per tick
[/spoiler]


Notes:
- This mod also technically includes the base Blessings since the framework removes them from the possible pool of options. (Just in-case someone else was making a mod and realized they weren't appearing like I did, or they also consider adding them) 
- Some of the newer additions to Custom Blessing Framework do not display their affects, this is just base game stuff and may be fixed. For now, you can check the spoiler tab to see what they all do/if something isn't showing up :)
- If you have any suggestions (either for better balance or for more to add) let me know!
- I might add more complex Blessings in the future pending me learning C#
- If anyone would like to add translations for my mod, you can use the documentation provided on the Custom Blessing Framework mod page, and send it to me via google drive and I will add it to the mod :)

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
